name: 17954 · Minersville, PA
findings: ZIP 17954 (Minersville) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17954 (Minersville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17954 (Minersville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
